evidenceNotes: Pinned BWAPI4.4.0/OpenBW data: Parasite is built in with no research,75energy,384px inclusive body range and nonbuilding ground/air targets. Friendly,self,enemy,organic and mechanical targets are supported; invisible,cargo and Stasis targets are refused. No damage or ownership change.

Authored scope: immediate single visible unit effect,no approach or original projectile/animation delay,18tick cooldown shared both ways with Ensnare,no autocast. Infection permanently ORs source owner bits and remains after source death,Stasis,burrow and unit morphs. Drone construction cancellation retains it; completed buildings and dead victims remove it.

Current sight,terrain/high-ground and active detector information is shared only with infecting players. Blindness reduces shared sight and disables detection; Stasis disables detection. Cargo retains infection but grants no sight/detection until unloading. The infected cloaked body is revealed without removing cloak or stopping energy drain. No enemy economy,commands or source mask is sent in render packets.

Restoration removes Parasite,blindness and Ensnare together for one existing50energy payment while preserving HP,Stim,cloak and Stasis. Friendly group targeting prioritizes removable statuses. Current/legacy validation checks masks,unique references,shared cooldowns,timers and map bounds.

640 game tests including22 Parasite tests pass; shared261,Haeru53,Baksal28 checks pass. Fresh canonical-source CI repeats npm ci,full npm test,lab build and benchmark. The exact final source includes the pre-existing Sites-only Haeru/Vite fixes,with no changes to the already validated Stark Rift files during integration.

Both portrait sizes locally and on production use actual Worker/Pixi/native touch and natural50-to75energy regeneration,no research or resource/state injection. Parasite is applied to an enemy Probe,then the friendly Lurker scout is loaded and all Queens retreat. Saved positions and original sight radii prove no friendly direct sight reaches the victim while the infected enemy remains visible. Active infection,cooldown,energy,orders,RNG,loaded scout and tracked vision roundtrip exactly.

Twenty untouched production saves from formats12..22 restore locally and on production at exact ticks,retaining raw backups,Queens/Ensnare/research/production,blindness/Medic/Stim,energy,cargo,cloak,siege,morphs,pending spells,groups,resources and RNG. Migration adds no Parasite record or grants. The built-in ability becomes available to existing Queens without rewriting their resources.

Production repeats the full Queen Ensnare/Gamete/production flow,Medic Optical/Restoration,and manual Recall/Stasis including complete thaw and normal movement afterward. Portrait-only rotation pause and absence of runtime/fatal errors are checked.

A first automation attempt remained in transport loading mode,so no retreat command was issued. Logs identified this; the harness now explicitly cancels loading before retreat. Earlier attempts are preserved separately and excluded from final passing counts. Initial concurrent browser/benchmark load produced a53ms p95; the isolated repeat measured about9.2ms for cross200 and completed all traffic gates.

Sites source had diverged from GitHub with4 pre-existing Haeru/Vite fixes. A true merge preserves both GitHub Parasite/StarDraft work and the actual Sites ancestry,without a force push. The final merge SHA and tree are identical on GitHub main,Sites source,the clean build and native saved/deployed version. All206 artifact files are individually SHA256 verified; lossless gzip packaging preserves all assets.

Chromium SwiftShader/native touch does not certify physical Android/iOS or hardware GPU performance. Queen Broodlings/Infest,autocast,multiplayer alliances,final graphics and strategic AI remain separate work.
